brief:
Al-Hiya and Dahlan held talks focused on advancing the second phase of a Gaza ceasefire agreement, Shehab Wire reported. The two officials examined mechanisms for rolling out the next stage of the truce accord, which has already begun initial implementation in the territory.

No public statements were issued regarding specific timelines or conditions for moving forward with phase two. The discussions reflect ongoing efforts by Palestinian factions to execute the multi-stage ceasefire framework aimed at halting fighting in Gaza.
